title: Private Pay Long-Term Care Residency — Accommodation Tiers and Clinical Placement Criteria
content:
**Admissions office schedule — Private Pay Long-Term Care Residency.** A private-pay admission agreement is held for one of six accommodation tiers. Each tier is entered only by a resident whose stay is paid privately and whose room matches the tier's description below; the two secure memory care tiers also require a dementia diagnosis on the care plan, and the bariatric room requires a bariatric care plan.

| Accommodation tier | Room type | Licensed beds in the room | On the secured memory care unit | Dementia diagnosis on the care plan required | Bariatric weight threshold (pounds) | Isolation billing tier | Care-plan review interval (days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Semi-Private Long-Term Care Room | semi-private | 2 | No | No | 0 (no weight criterion) | Semi-Private Long-Term Care Room | 92 |
| Semi-Private Secure Memory Care Room | semi-private | 2 | Yes | Yes | 0 (no weight criterion) | Semi-Private Secure Memory Care Room | 92 |
| Private Long-Term Care Room | private | 1 | No | No | 0 (no weight criterion) | Semi-Private Long-Term Care Room | 92 |
| Private Secure Memory Care Room | private | 1 | Yes | Yes | 0 (no weight criterion) | Semi-Private Secure Memory Care Room | 92 |
| Private Bariatric Care Room | private | 1 | No | No | 350 | Semi-Private Long-Term Care Room | 92 |
| Private Suite with Sitting Area | suite | 1 | No | No | 0 (no weight criterion) | Semi-Private Long-Term Care Room | 92 |

**Reading the columns.**
- *Bariatric weight threshold* is the smallest documented weight that qualifies for the bariatric room; a figure of 0 means the tier has no weight criterion.
- *Isolation billing tier* is the tier whose rate applies when the center itself moves the resident into a room of this tier for infection control.
- *Care-plan review interval* is the longest gap, in days, between the care-plan reviews that confirm the tier's clinical criteria (the quarterly assessment cycle).

**Room changes, all six tiers.** A room change the resident requests reprices from the move date at the new tier's own rate, and needs no advance rate-change notice.

**Points of judgement (from the table).**
- A resident documented at 350 pounds meets the bariatric room's weight criterion; a resident documented at 349 pounds does not.
- The Private Suite with Sitting Area and the Private Long-Term Care Room both have the Semi-Private Long-Term Care Room as their isolation billing tier; the Private Secure Memory Care Room has the Semi-Private Secure Memory Care Room.
